summary.zh: 「技能与 MCP」菜单读取 inventory 的 target_class：指纹相同但目标不同的 MCP 不再列为「不同名 · 同指纹」重复组，mcp_hints 以一行信息显示在按重复看的末尾，不计入重复数。旧版 agent-pack 没有这两个键时分组与输出不变。
summary.en: The Skills & MCP menu reads target_class from the inventory: MCP entries with the same fingerprint but a different target no longer form a "different names, same fingerprint" duplicate group, and mcp_hints appear as one line at the end of the by-duplicate view without counting as duplicates. With an older agent-pack that lacks both keys, grouping and output are unchanged.
